question: Three Indians were named amongst Time Magazine's '100 Most Influential People' of 2021. Who among the following is NOT one of them?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Gautam Adani.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gautam Shantilal Adani** is an Indian billionaire industrialist.
 
• He is the** chairman and founder of the Adani Group,** an Ahmedabad-based **multinational conglomerate** involved in port development and operations in India.
 
• Adani is also the **president of the Adani Foundation,** which is primarily led by his wife, Priti Adani.
 
• He has seven siblings. His family was **involved in the textile business.**
 
• **Infrastructure tycoon** Gautam Adani controls Mundra Port, India's largest, in his home state of Gujarat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19dae7b9b9cb0f4b241ca4129848efe2973afca743b4e8e364137f588697fbc3.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Narendra Damodardas Modi** is an Indian politician serving as the 14th and current prime minister of India since 2014.​ 
 
• **Mamata Banerjee** is an Indian politician who is serving as the **eighth and current chief minister of the Indian state of West Bengal since 20 May 2011**, the first woman to hold the office.
 
• Adar Poonawalla (born 14 January 1981) is an Indian** billionaire businessman.** He is the chief **executive officer (CEO) of the Serum Institute of India.**
